crypto_headlines.title: Bitcoin closes at a 30-day low near $80,500
crypto_headlines.summary: CryptoQuant's Axel Adler says BTC closed Saturday at $80,500, a new 30-day low, after bouncing off its 365-day moving average. He notes tight ranges like this usually end with a sharp move.

crypto_headlines.title: Middle East tensions keep crypto under pressure
crypto_headlines.summary: X's news summary ties the weekend drop under $80,000 to rising US-Iran tensions, with more than $200M in leveraged longs liquidated in one hour. BTC was stabilizing near $80,000 by Sunday.

crypto_headlines.title: Spot Bitcoin ETFs log back-to-back outflows
crypto_headlines.summary: Per X's news summary, US spot Bitcoin ETFs saw $635.6M leave on Oct 22, the biggest one-day outflow since June, followed by $137.9M on Oct 23, led by BlackRock's IBIT.

crypto_headlines.title: X to add $1 tips on the like button
crypto_headlines.summary: Elon Musk says X is adding a long-press on the like button that sends someone $1 through X Money.

crypto_headlines.title: Keystone wallet site breach exposes customer data
crypto_headlines.summary: Hardware wallet maker Keystone says attackers accessed its website and took customer names, contact details, home addresses and order info. Seed phrases and keys were not affected, so watch for fake support scams.

crypto_headlines.title: Cardone Capital buys the dip
crypto_headlines.summary: Bitcoin Magazine reports Cardone Capital bought 16 BTC worth about $1.28M during the pullback.

doginal_news.title: NC tournament trends on X
doginal_news.summary: The community's DDLTCG tournament in North Carolina, played for the NC Do Only Good Foundation, ran into Saturday night and pushed Doginal Dogs into X's trending list.

doginal_news.title: First official DDLTCG Championship announced
doginal_news.summary: Doginal Dogs Legends TCG announced its first official Championship, an in-person tournament for the top players from around the world. Details are in the post.

doginal_news.title: Cards headed for grading
doginal_news.summary: A community member says CGC has started authenticating Legends TCG cards, with more sent to BGS and PSA.

doginal_news.title: Hobby shop play draws new faces
doginal_news.summary: Playing DDL at a local hobby shop brought curious customers asking about the art and the boxes, with thanks to the event hosts.

doginal_news.title: Marketplace wallet setup guide
doginal_news.summary: A community walkthrough shows how to set up a wallet on the Doginal Dogs marketplace, add X verification and get around the site.

doginal_news.title: Pyth Pro MCP Server 1.1 in the spotlight
doginal_news.summary: Community posts are highlighting Pyth Pro MCP Server 1.1, which lets AI agents pull tick-level price history and look up pairs by name across crypto, equities, FX and more.

notes: Doginal Dogs and DDLTCG's own accounts mostly reposted community posts in the last 24 hours, and @PythNetwork had no new standalone posts, so items link to the original community posts. Summaries are written from the linked posts. Not financial advice.
